editorial: Lights flicker across an almost‑black corridor as you join a rag‑tag team of government saboteurs planning a high‑stakes heist. Operation Fortune’s unique blend of gritty espionage and biting satire keeps you guessing about who’s playing each card. Joaquin Phoenix, with a quiet menace that turns subtle gestures into a silver-lining climax, anchors the film’s most unpredictable turn. A few pacing hiccups thicken the third act, but the payoff is well worth the trip back to the front lines. You’ll feel your pulse quicken as every shot feels like a dial steeper toward an explosive finish.
targetAudience: Ideal for fans of psychological thrillers who enjoy non-linear storytelling.
